mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This meal is a small serving of fresh fruit, consisting of green grapes and a fig, with naturally occurring sugars that can raise blood sugar levels in someone with diabetes. It is best to limit portion size and pair fruit with a protein- or high-fiber food, opting for lower-glycemic, high-fiber alternatives instead when needed.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A small bowl containing fresh green grapes and one fresh fig.
